item.title: Finance history catalogue
item.description:
Not investment advice. Dates below are when money or a ticker enters the public graphene conversation. Figures are as contemporaneous media or official text stated them. Competing “first IPO” claims are left side by side.

Before a graphene ticker (to 2012)

When What Label Notes
2004–2010 Academic isolation + Nobel weather Well-supported science; finance is weather National labs and universities spend; not a sector of stocks. [[timeline/2004]] · [[timeline/2010]]
2010 Durham Graphene Science (later AGM) spin-out Well-supported as a company origin in later IPO copy University spin-out, not yet listed
Apr 2010 Haydale Limited acquired into what becomes Haydale Graphene Industries Company-history as later told at IPO Plasma functionalization shop, 2003 nanoparticle roots
Feb 2012 IP Group seed into AGM path, about US$1.9 million in contemporaneous Nanalyze writeup Preliminary (secondary) University-IP money, still private
2011 Graphene Frontiers (UPenn) founded Well-supported as a startup that later took NSF money Later reported shut
2011 NanoXplore founded (Canada) Company-stated origin Listing comes later

CVD Equipment (NASDAQ: CVV) already existed as a tools company. Graftech existed as graphite. Those are adjacent tickers, not graphene IPOs.

item.title: How we log dollar figures
item.description:
Not advice. A figure on this site is a quoted statement plus a label.

Prefer

  1. A primary: SEDAR+/ASX/AIM notice, SEC filing, DOE/EC page, company PDF.
  2. The unit next to the number.
  3. Date the statement was made.

Trade portals (Graphene-Info and cousins) are radar. They can introduce a name or a date. They are not the shelf. [[guides/sources]]

Treat as Preliminary

  • Small-cell cost talk.
  • Company-stated capacity until a third party or a consistent production report exists.
  • A tonne figure that exists only in a portal paraphrase.

Treat as Unsourced / forecast

  • “The graphene market will be $Y billion in 20ZZ.”
  • Price targets.
  • Screenshots of a ticker with no filing.

Stock movements

Listings, announced raises, grants. Not “up 12% today.”

item.title: Public programmes and awards
item.description:
Not advice. These are documented public-sector numbers.

European Commission — Graphene Flagship

  • Jan 2013: selected as an FET Flagship. Commission communications used a €1 billion over 10 years envelope figure. That was a programme scale, not a wire of €1bn on day one. [[timeline/2013]]
  • Oct 2013 kickoff: ramp-up often cited as €54 million EC / 30 months for the first phase.
  • Mandate included graphene and related layered materials.

Label: Well-supported as Commission programme text. Not a valuation of any AIM/ASX name.

item.title: Public raises 2015-2025
item.description:
Not investment advice. Gross as the notice stated.

Parent: [[topics/finance]] · [[topics/finance/how-we-log-figures]]

2015

  • Nov 2015 — Haydale. FY2016 results recap: placing and open offer raised £6.0 million (before costs). 2 Nov 2015 prelims had already flagged a conditional placing (~£5.6 million plus £1.0 million open-offer clawback language). Well-supported as year-end RNS recap of a completed raise.

2016

  • 27 May 2016 — Directa Plus AIM ~£12.8 million at 75p.
  • 23 Sep 2016 — Haydale. Result of placing: ~1.27 million new shares at 160p for about £2.0 million, plus director/management subscription £55,600. Tied to the ACM acquisition story in the same morning’s release. Well-supported result-of-placing RNS. FY2017 later also cites an oversubscribed placing and open offer of £2.59 million before expenses financing ACM — do not double-count without reading both notices side by side; the September 160p line is the one with a same-day result RNS.

2017

  • 27 Jan 2017 — FGR A$3.52 million at A$0.11 (asxpdf 20170127).
  • Aug 2017 — NanoXplore ~C$9.70 million RTO.
  • Haydale FY2017 results (10 Oct 2017): strategic investment £3.26 million by Everpower International (9.9%). That is a named strategic stake in the RNS highlights, not a marketed placing.

2018

  • 13 Mar 2018 — FGR A$3.2 million at 18c.
  • 11–17 Dec 2018 — FGR A$1.45–1.50 million at 15c.
  • 12 Dec 2018 — Directa Plus. Result of placing RNS: 6,300,000 new shares at 50p for £3.15 million (4,256,000 firm + 2,044,000 conditional). Firm admission 17 Dec 2018; conditional admission 9 Jan 2019. Circular also launched an open offer of up to ~2.01 million shares. FY2018 results later call the whole capital raise £3.45 million with £1.32 million booked after year-end — placing £3.15 million plus open-offer cash. Well-supported RNS 3006K.

2019

  • Jan 2019 — NanoXplore ~C$21 million share leg + convertibles.
  • April 2019 — FGR A$3.5 million at 15c.
  • 22 Feb 2019 — Haydale £4.0 million placing/sub at 2p + open offer up to another £4.0 million.

2020

  • 3 Apr 2020 — NanoXplore C$25.0 million.
  • 12 Jun 2020 — FGR entitlements A$6.2 million.
  • 9 Sep 2020 — Haydale. Result of fundraising RNS: £2.98 million gross; 85,055,950 new shares at 3.5p. Admission around 15 Sep 2020. Well-supported (no longer Preliminary).

2021

  • 12 Feb 2021 — NanoXplore C$46 million.
  • Jan 2021 — AGM ~£6 million (later circular).
  • Apr / Sep 2021 — GMG list + ~C$11.55 million.

2022

  • 13 Sep 2022 — Haydale ~£5.51 million placing/sub/open offer at 2p.

2023

  • AGM to Universal Matter US$1.3 million.
  • 16 Aug 2023 — GMG ~C$3.45 million.
  • 15 Sep 2023 — Haydale £5.0 million at 0.5p + retail up to £1.0 million.
  • 21 Dec 2023 — FGR SPP A$2.91 million.

2024

  • 30 Apr 2024 — NanoXplore C$60 million facility (debt).
  • Jun 2024 — Directa Plus ~£6.8–6.9 million at 18p.
  • Nov 2024 — Haydale ~£3.1 million + £0.5 million CLN.

2025

  • 19 Feb 2025 — FGR ~A$2.4 million.
  • Haydale 2025 / 7 Jan 2026 £5.75 million as logged.
